verdict.rationale: Hugging Face is a hosted platform with paid tiers (Inference Endpoints, Inference Providers), so a stated availability SLA is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, availability commitment, or service credits for any paid or enterprise tier. The cited pricing, routing and provider-selection docs are adjacent features, not an availability guarantee.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a stated availability SLA on paid or enterprise tiers
